question: A non-linear resistor has a current-voltage characteristic curve (I-V graph) given by $I = kV^2$, where $k$ is a constant. Analyze the 'dynamic resistance' $r_d$ (defined as the inverse slope $\frac{dV}{dI}$) at a specific operating voltage $V$. Determine the ratio of the static resistance $R_{stat}$ (defined as $\frac{V}{I}$) to the dynamic resistance $r_d$ at this voltage.
